args.body: Hi Dora! I just visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com) and wanted to share some feedback. It's great that you have a personal site to showcase yourself! I noticed it's fairly minimal at the moment — just a brief introduction and your email. You might consider adding more content, such as details about your background, projects, interests, or a portfolio section. Also, including a contact form or links to your social profiles could make it easier for visitors to connect with you. Keep up the good work!

Hi Eve! I just checked out your blog (www.eve-blog.com) and wanted to share some feedback. I love that your blog is centered around hiking — that's a wonderful hobby with so much to share! You could make your blog even more engaging by adding posts about your favorite trails, hiking tips, gear recommendations, or photos from your adventures. A bit more content and structure would really bring your passion for hiking to life for your readers. Happy hiking!
